## Purpose
Complete the conditional FLRW production solver before the signed non-tilted axisymmetric Bianchi I campaign and isotope abundance histories.

## Implemented and published
- Replace repeated physical-energy projection with fixed covariant reference-energy moments, positive threshold-split reconstruction, source subcells and the existing coupled cold H/He Newton owner.
- Add an explicit FLRW inactive-HI pool with total photon number/energy/work preservation, strong active/passive error norm and V4 checkpoints.
- Add the standalone conditional Grackle H-equality deuterium atomic provider and isotope-native point RHS; cosmological activation remains pending.

Unit1: a71052cec02c48c08d6823e00331fab1db654a76. Unit2: 54dd5352672127e77970eb06f3dda027f2aee275.

## Evidence
Reuse the previous28 completed checks and historical full runs. New distinct checks:22 in Unit1 and11 in Unit2. Preserve first failures and focused repairs. Independent reviews admit these scoped components and a fresh finite NCP pilot. The cut-cell control reduced the local discrepancy by14.97x; this is not a runtime speedup or full-history convergence claim.

The first unpartitioned pilot reached its20,000-step cap. Its complete raw archive is backed up separately. Actual64-core/128GB NCP stage002 builds and source/config readback passed; a fresh cut-cell q128 pilot was launched. Current outcomes are tracked in research/flrw_covariant_transport_20261015/.

## Current next action
The owner explicitly requested adequate64-core/128GB utilization. Implement and measure persistent cell-level parallelism and concurrent prescribed refinement cases with deterministic reductions and unchanged physical acceptance. The prior one-thread/two-case limits are historical for immutable stage002, not a permanent allocation limit.

Full FLRW refinement, Bianchi histories, cosmological D/additional-isotope coupling and final time/actual-Tgas plots remain pending. Do not promote these to complete from unit tests or conservation alone.

## Resume and preservation
Read AGENTS.md and research/flrw_covariant_transport_20261015/{HANDOFF,NEXT_DAG,INDEPENDENT_REVIEW,CUT_CELL_REVIEW,UNIT2_DELIVERY_RECEIPT}.json. Unit1 and Unit2 runnable ZIPs plus the first pilot raw ZIP were uploaded to Google Drive and Dropbox. Durable source-bound checkpoints and exact next actions are retained.
